experiments.title: Repeat: bench, day 2
experiments.what: E5 again: eight pages, Jev and vibium check on the same settled page

experiments.what: E11 again: fresh Sonnet agents, same neutral images, same claim-only prompts

experiments.title: Repeat: corpus with recordings, day 2
